mapper.select: SELECT pr.review_id AS reviewId, pr.member_id AS memberId, m.last_name || ' ' || m.first_name AS memberName, pr.product_id AS productId, pr.rating, pr.title, pr.body, pr.published, CAST(pr.created_at AS timestamp) AS createdAt, CAST(pr.updated_at AS timestamp) AS updatedAt FROM product_review pr LEFT JOIN members m ON pr.member_id = m.member_id -- ★ 会員テーブルと結合 WHERE pr.product_id = #{productId} AND pr.published = true ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND published = true
SELECT AVG(rating) AS averageRating, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND published = true

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, member_id AS memberId, product_id AS productId, rating, title, body, published, CAST(created_at AS timestamp) AS createdAt, CAST(updated_at AS timestamp) AS updatedAt FROM product_review WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review ( member_id, product_id, rating, title, body, published, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{form.productId}, #{form.rating}, #{form.title}, #{form.body}, true, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_review SET rating = #{form.rating}, title = #{form.title}, body = #{form.body}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{form.productId}
